content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Payment gateway

No-KYC payment gateways allow digital sellers to process transactions without traditional know-your-customer (KYC) requirements. This means that sellers can operate without the bureaucratic hurdles imposed by many conventional platforms. In a market where platforms often charge excessive fees, like Gumroad's 10%, alternatives like NOWPayments provide a low-cost option at only 0.5%. This significant difference enables creators to retain more of their earnings and ensures that financial sovereignty is within their reach.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the core of a no-KYC payment gateway is the ability to process transactions in cryptocurrency, which simplifies the payment process. The architecture typically employs cloud-based services like Cloudflare Workers for backend processing and Google Drive for file delivery. These components work together seamlessly, ensuring that digital products are delivered automatically upon payment confirmation. By integrating NOWPayments, sellers can also enjoy instant conversion of crypto payments to USD, facilitating a straightforward pricing model without the risks associated with traditional payment processors.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where access to mainstream payment platforms is restricted or non-existent. Individuals selling ebooks, courses, plugins, and other digital products need a reliable way to monetize their work. By utilizing no-KYC payment gateways, these creators can avoid high fees associated with platforms like Gumroad, thereby maximizing their revenue potential. The architecture is built for those who value ownership and control over their sales process.
Retain more earnings with lower fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effective operation of a no-KYC payment gateway relies on several key components. Cloudflare Pages or Google Apps Script can be used for hosting and backend logic, while Supabase or Google Sheets serves as order storage. File delivery can be handled through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring that products reach buyers without delay. All of these elements are integrated with NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, creating a cohesive system that empowers digital creators to manage their sales independently.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To implement a no-KYC payment gateway, start by selecting your hosting solution, like Cloudflare Pages. Next, configure your backend logic using Google Apps Script. Set up your order storage through Supabase or Google Sheets. After this, integrate NOWPayments to handle your cryptocurrency transactions. Finally, ensure that your digital products are ready for delivery through your chosen method. For a comprehensive solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates to streamline your deployment.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Achieve financial sovereignty by owning your infrastructure.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, using a no-KYC payment gateway is the best option. Our Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers everything you need to build and deploy your own sovereign digital commerce stack. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
What are no-KYC payment gateways?
No-KYC payment gateways enable transactions without the traditional identity verification processes, allowing sellers to operate freely without sharing sensitive personal information.
Can I use no-KYC payment gateways for selling courses?
Yes, no-KYC payment gateways can be effectively utilized for selling courses, enabling creators to receive payments directly in cryptocurrency without platform restrictions.
Are there alternatives to Gumroad for selling digital products?
Absolutely. Platforms like NOWPayments allow you to sell digital products directly, avoiding the high fees associated with services like Gumroad.
How can I retain more of my earnings when selling digital products?
By using a no-KYC payment gateway like NOWPayments, which charges only a 0.5% fee compared to higher fees from traditional platforms, you can maximize your earnings.
What digital products can I sell using no-KYC payment gateways?
You can sell a wide range of digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, beats, plugins, and software using no-KYC payment gateways.
